title: Recipe to order: building in public
progress: I’m building a restaurant ordering harness for the Meta AI hackathon. The first milestone is repeatable checks for recipe scaling, inventory deductions, vendor pack rounding and source-backed prices.
next: Connect Meta recipe interpretation to a visible order worksheet using assistant-ui and Mastra.
ask: Restaurant operators: what causes the most ordering mistakes—units, pack sizes, substitutions or stale price lists?
xText:
Building a restaurant ordering harness for the Meta AI hackathon: recipe → ingredient needs → vendor packs → priced order draft. Starting with evals, then adding assistant-ui + Mastra + Meta.
